d:
Some love songs never fade away, and “Aankhon Mein Base Ho Tum” is one such timeless romantic melody! Enjoy this beautiful song in stunning 8K video quality from the 1995 Bollywood film Takkar, featuring the charming on-screen pairing of Suniel Shetty and Sonali Bendre. With the soulful voices of Alka Yagnik and Abhijeet, this unforgettable romantic duet captures the magic of 90s Bollywood music.
